Container.Name: vsdpad
Container.Overview: VSD Pad server: edit the pages, keys, themes and plugins of your VSD M18 / Stream Deck pads from any browser on your network. The PC with the pads plugged in follows this server and picks up every change by itself (run.py --connect http://[IP]:8765 --password ... once on that PC).
Container.Requires: Your PC runs VSD Pad 2 with the pads plugged in, and connects to this server once with --connect.

Config.Name: Settings page port
Config.Description: The settings page and the port your PC connects to.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Your layout, its history, pictures, themes and icon packs. Holds your Home Assistant / Hue tokens: keep it private.

Config.Name: Password
Config.Description: Password for the settings page (any user name) and for your PC to connect.

Config.Name: GitHub token (updates)
Config.Description: Optional. A read-only GitHub token for the vsdpad repository (Contents: Read-only). With it, the server hands new versions of the Windows app to your PC, so the PC needs no token of its own.

Config.Name: Time zone
Config.Description: For the clock and day/night previews.
